title: Follow-On US-Iran Geneva Talks Abruptly Postponed
detail: Follow-on talks in Geneva, intended to advance the signed MOU toward a permanent peace deal, were abruptly postponed. The underlying ceasefire and Strait of Hormuz reopening held despite the postponement. Brent crude rose modestly on the news, though it remained well below its pre-MOU levels as the broader de-escalation trend stayed intact.
